issue.title: Attribute the selection escalation-rate delta to coverage contexts
issue.description: Coverage contexts (sase-fp.6) union real per-test hits into the diff-scoped selection on top of the static import-graph closure, and just selection-health reports a rule histogram (which rule -- contract-set-only, broadening, escalation, etc. -- fired) but cannot attribute how much of any escalation-rate delta is caused by coverage contexts specifically versus the static closure. Because contexts widen selection for changes in widely-executed modules, revisit whether the escalation guard's 0.25 max-ratio is still the right threshold once that attribution is possible. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3), originally proposed during sase-fp.6 (Coverage-context ground truth for selection).
